scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)
other_conditions: The enterprise must be a micro, small or medium enterprise (MSME) operating in the powerloom sector.
Production must have started between 01‑01‑2022 and 31‑12‑2024.
A four‑party agreement must be executed with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja.
The unit may be a private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government and Industrial SHGs.
The project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose.
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, a Commercial Bank or a State Financial Institution.
benefits_summary: Refund of 30% (zones B & C) or 50% (zones D & E) of net SGST paid for up to 8 years, subject to a cumulative cap of 75% of the fixed capital investment.
